providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.blurb: Easiest on Android. Free Google AI Studio key with your Google account — no credit card.
providers.whyEasy: Use the Google account already on this phone. In AI Studio tap Get API key → Create API key, then paste the WHOLE key back here (prefix can vary).
guide: Tap “Open Google AI Studio keys” below (browser opens).
Sign in with the Google account on this phone.
Get API key → Create API key (new project is fine). Accept any Google prompts to enable the API.
Copy the FULL key (do not worry about the prefix) → return to Forge → paste → Save & test.
steps: Open Google AI Studio API keys and sign in with Google.
Create API key (free). If Google asks to enable Generative Language API, allow it.
Paste the full key below — any prefix is OK; do not add quotes or “API_KEY=”.

providers.name: Groq
providers.blurb: Truly free tier (rate-limited). Sign up with Google/GitHub/email, copy a gsk_ key.
providers.whyEasy: No credit card for the free tier. Fast models — great if Gemini misbehaves.
guide: Sign up or log in (Google / GitHub / email).
API Keys → Create API Key → copy (usually starts with gsk_).
Return to Forge, paste the key, tap Save & test.
steps: Open Groq Console and sign up (Google/GitHub/email).
Go to API Keys → Create API Key.
Copy the key (starts with gsk_) and paste below.

providers.name: OpenRouter (free models)
providers.blurb: One key; pick free models (names ending in :free). Good backup brain.
providers.whyEasy: Sign up, create a key, Forge defaults to a free model router. No need to pay to try.
guide: Tap “Open OpenRouter” below and sign up.
Return to Forge, paste, Save & test.
Stay on free models (Forge sets a free default).
steps: Sign up at OpenRouter.
Create an API key.
Paste it below (often starts with sk-or-).

providers.name: Cheaper Inference
providers.blurb: One OpenAI-compatible key for many models (GLM, DeepSeek, GPT, Claude…) often below list price. Wallet-backed — not a free tier.
providers.whyEasy: Create an account, fund the wallet (first top-up often includes bonus credit), mint an ir_live_ key, then Forge pulls the live model catalog (includes glm-5.2).
guide: Tap “Open Cheaper Inference” and create an account.
Add wallet credit (check dashboard for any first-fund bonus).
Create an API key (starts with ir_live_) and copy it once.
Return to Forge, paste the key, Save & test. Use Refresh models if the list looks stale.
steps: Sign up at cheaperinference.com and open the dashboard.
Fund the wallet, then create an API key (ir_live_…).
Paste the key below. Default model is glm-5.2; Refresh models loads the live catalog.

providers.name: xAI Grok (API)
providers.blurb: Grok chat apps can be free, but the developer API usually needs paid xAI credits.
providers.whyEasy: Only use this if you already bought xAI API credits. For free setup pick Gemini or Groq instead.
guide: Open the xAI console and sign in.
Add billing / credits if the console requires it.
Create an API key (starts with xai-) and paste below.
steps: Open the xAI API console (not only the Grok consumer app).
API access normally needs credits — free Grok chat ≠ free API.
Create a key (xai-…) only after billing allows API calls.

providers.name: Hugging Face
providers.blurb: Free token; rate limits apply. Use router OpenAI-compatible API.
steps: Create a Hugging Face account.
Settings → Access Tokens → New token (read is enough to start).
Paste the token (starts with hf_).

providers.name: Cerebras
providers.blurb: Free tier with very fast inference.
steps: Sign up on Cerebras Cloud.
Create an API key in the dashboard.
Paste the key below.

providers.name: Ollama (on this phone)
providers.blurb: Fully free via Termux — no cloud key. Needs Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible local server.
steps: In Termux (with forge-termux-agent running): install/run a local OpenAI-compatible server, or use a PC on your LAN.
Default assumes http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 (Ollama).
Leave API key blank or use ollama — then Save & test.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.blurb: Official OpenAI API. Requires billing on most accounts.
steps: Sign up / log in to OpenAI Platform.
Create a secret key.
Paste it (starts with sk-).
